description: Store a post as a DRAFT in SocialStudio — title and text, optionally a reel script (one short line per tile). Write the text out in the user's language and their brand's tone; do not invent numbers, prices or dates. Nothing is posted: attach images with update_social_post, render the reel with render_social_reel; the user shares it. If the account has several brands, ask which one and pass brand_id (see list_brands).

brand_id.description: The brand from list_brands — needed if there are several.

reel_lines.description: Only for a reel: one line per tile (up to 80 characters each) — the first is the hook, the last the close.

name: create_social_post
title: Create social post draft
